text.description_html:
Fusion P-04-A2/100-A2-BSS Stainless Steel Industrial Design Entryset

This brushed stainless steel passage knob and single cylinder deadbolt set features the clean simple lines that are characteristic of the contemporary industrial look. A Fusion made entry knob lock set, it is both chic and streamlined. This stainless steel deadbolt and door knob entryset has a limited lifetime warranty.

The simple industrial design will look great in loft apartments, contemporary office spaces and single family homes. For use on interior or exterior doors that need security locking.

Also Available: Matching Fusion 04-A2 Industrial Design Door Knob for your interior doors.

Features of the Stainless Steel Industrial Design Entry Knob set:

  • 1" throw deadbolt with Interior security roll pins.
  • Heavy-Duty strike with 3 screws for added security.
  • Solid brass schlage SC1 keyway & 5 pin system.
  • Cycle tested to ANSI standards.
  • Concealed screw assembly for sleek appearance.
  • Includes complete passage function door knob set and one single cylinder deadbolt lock.

Specifications of the Fusion P-04-A2/100-A2-BSS Stainless Steel Industrial Design Entryset:

  • Knob Diameter: 2"
  • Knob Projection: 1-7/8"
  • Rose Diameter: 2-7/8"
  • Rose Projection: 3/8”
  • Deadbolt Height: 2-1/2"
  • Deadbolt Projection: 1"
  • Adjustable Door Thickness 1-1/4" to 2"
  • Backsets: Either 2-3/8" or 2-3/4"
  • Standard Latch Rotation is 40 Degrees.
  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Brushed Stainless Steel
  • Lifetime Limited Warranty on workmanship, materials, and operation.

The Single Cylinder Deadbolt is thrown and retracted by a key from the exterior and a thumbturn from the interior while the Passage Knob Set latch operates from either side of the door by turning the knobs.
